title: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Spaghetti tossed with eggs, grated pecorino, crispy pancetta and plenty of black pepper. The heat of the pasta cooks the eggs into a silky sauce.

title: Margherita Pizza
description: A thin dough topped with tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and basil, baked in a very hot oven until the crust blisters. Finish with a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Sunday Lasagna
description: Layers of fresh pasta sheets, slow-cooked beef ragu and creamy bechamel. Start the ragu early in the morning: brown the beef with onion, carrot, celery and a little garlic, add red wine and tomatoes, then let it simmer gently for at least two hours. While it cooks, make the bechamel with butter, flour, warm milk and a pinch of nutmeg. Build the dish in a deep tray, alternating pasta, ragu and bechamel, and finish with a thick layer of parmesan. Bake until the top is golden and bubbling, then rest it for twenty minutes before cutting so the layers hold together. It feeds a whole family.

title: Garlic Bread
description: Slices of baguette spread with soft butter, crushed garlic and parsley, then baked until golden and crisp.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Pieces of chicken marinated in yogurt and warm spices, grilled, then simmered in a creamy tomato sauce. Serve with rice or naan.

title: Chicken Vindaloo
description: A fiery curry of chicken cooked in a spicy paste of dried chilies, vinegar and garlic. Spicy food lovers ask for extra chili.

title: Vegetable Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with vegetables, fried onions, saffron and whole spices, then steamed in a sealed pot.

title: Spicy Chicken Tacos
description: Soft tortillas filled with spicy chipotle chicken, shredded cabbage, lime and fresh salsa.

title: Guacamole
description: Ripe avocados mashed with lime juice, onion, tomato and cilantro. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Chicken Teriyaki
description: Chicken thighs pan-fried and glazed with a sweet sauce of soy, mirin and sugar. Serve over steamed rice.

title: Miso Soup
description: A light broth of dashi and miso paste with cubes of tofu, seaweed and spring onion.

title: Roast Chicken
description: A whole chicken rubbed with butter, lemon and thyme, roasted until the skin is crisp. Use the pan juices for gravy.

title: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: A small chocolate cake baked for just a few minutes so the centre stays molten. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Triple Chocolate Brownies
description: Chocolate, chocolate and more chocolate: melted dark chocolate in the batter, chocolate chips inside and a chocolate glaze on top.

title: New York Cheesecake
description: A rich cheesecake of cream cheese, sugar and eggs baked slowly on a graham cracker crust, then chilled overnight.

title: Fluffy Pancakes
description: Pancakes made with buttermilk and a little baking powder, cooked on a hot griddle and served with maple syrup.

title: Olive Tapenade
description: Black olives, capers and anchovies blended into a coarse paste. Spread it on toast brushed with oil.
